title: EventFlow
summary: Spring Boot event management platform with discovery, bookings, and role-based administration.

screenshots.caption: EventFlow public homepage and event discovery
Administration dashboard, metrics, and event analytics

overview: EventFlow is a Spring Boot web application for exploring events, managing registrations, and handling event administration. The public and administrative interfaces shown here are original screenshots from the deployed project.
purpose: Provide one platform for discovering events, registering for activities, and managing operations through role-aware administration.
features: Public event discovery with category navigation and search
Participant and organizer accounts with role-based access
architecture: Spring Boot MVC and Thymeleaf for server-rendered pages; Spring Security for authorization; MongoDB persistence. Deployment runs on Render.

title: Food Mobo Chain
summary: Food Mobo Chain is a full-stack food ordering and management platform designed to connect customers with local food carts. It provides food discovery, menu browsing, ordering workflows, seller management, and an administrative dashboard for managing platform operations.

screenshots.caption: Food Mobo Chain landing page and food-discovery interface
Admin dashboard with platform statistics, orders, payments, and management options
Admin food-cart management with owners, locations, approvals, and actions

overview: Food Mobo Chain is a full-stack food ordering and management platform designed to connect customers with local food carts. It provides food discovery, menu browsing, ordering workflows, seller management, and an administrative dashboard for managing platform operations.
purpose: Connect customers with local food carts and provide tools for managing food discovery, ordering, seller activity, and platform operations.
features: Food menus, categories, and ordering workflows
Order management, payment tracking, and promotional offers
architecture: Java and Spring Boot web application with Thymeleaf views, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and MySQL persistence.

title: Afsos Nama
summary: Afsos Nama is a student-focused reflection and personal improvement platform designed to help students record their semester experiences, recognize recurring mistakes, and turn lessons learned into meaningful actions. It provides a private workspace for tracking reflections, identifying patterns, and setting personal improvement goals.

screenshots.caption: Afsos Nama login page, branding, and reflection dashboard preview

overview: Afsos Nama is a student-focused reflection and personal improvement platform designed to help students record their semester experiences, recognize recurring mistakes, and turn lessons learned into meaningful actions. It provides a private workspace for tracking reflections, identifying patterns, and setting personal improvement goals.
purpose: Give students a private space to reflect on semester experiences, learn from recurring mistakes, and track practical improvement goals.
features: Private personal reflection and confession tracking
Creating and tracking personal improvement promises
architecture: Java and Spring Boot web application using Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and MySQL, with Thymeleaf-rendered pages and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the interface.

title: Student Excuse Generator
summary: JavaFX desktop application for generating formatted student excuse documents.
overview: A Java and JavaFX application that uses structured user input to produce formatted student excuse documents.
purpose: Provide a reusable interface for entering information and generating documents in a desktop workflow.
features: Desktop interface with login and dashboard screens
Structured form for generating student excuse documents
architecture: Java and JavaFX desktop UI; original portfolio includes the screen sequence.

title: Hospital Management System
summary: JavaFX software for hospital records, patient and doctor workflows.
overview: Java and JavaFX desktop software for managing hospital-related records and common administrative workflows.
purpose: Bring patient, doctor and administrative tasks into one desktop application.
architecture: JavaFX graphical user interface and database-backed application structure.

title: Plant Disease Recognition
summary: CNN-based classification of plant leaf conditions using images.
overview: A deep-learning application that classifies image inputs of plant leaves using a convolutional neural network.
purpose: Explore image-based disease recognition as a practical CNN classification task.
architecture: CNN image-classification workflow, shown by the original portfolio screens.

title: Ovijog
summary: Community problem reporting platform and an end-to-end DevOps learning project.
overview: A community-focused problem reporting concept, developed with a practical Java/Spring Boot and DevOps workflow.
purpose: Let people report a broad range of community issues through a public interface.
architecture: Spring Boot backend with DevOps workflow using Docker, AWS, and GitHub Actions.
